content.text:
Recap for the Couch Captain flight (Feb 11–15, 2027, America/Phoenix):

**Totals**
- Spend: ~$633.12 of the $650 budget (never overspent; daily pacing held)
- Impressions: ~484,500
- Link clicks: 186
- Completed entries ("Photo entered" pixel, reported as sign-ups): 17

**Setup & management**
- One campaign ("Couch Captain – Super Bowl 2027", z513f), four ad groups — one per approved post, no new posts written. Objective WEBSITE_CLICKS with optimization toward the "Photo entered" web event tag (x8fqz), placements ALL_ON_TWITTER, US-only targeting, age 21+ (AGE_OVER_21), matching the contest's eligibility policy.
- Day 1–2: even split at $32.50/day per post. After day 2, shifted budget toward stronger posts (A/B/C) and cut D; on day 3 raised C (deadline copy, best conversion rate) to $35/day. D (eligibility copy) was consistently the weakest and got the smallest share.
- Per-post clicks: A (audience) 49, B (inherited estate) 72, C (deadline) 39, D (eligibility) 26. Entries by post: A 4, B 4, C 6, D 3.
- All line items were paused after the flight ended Feb 16, 07:00 UTC (Phoenix midnight); the campaign is no longer serving or spending.

**Notes**
- Conversion volume is small (17 entries), so per-post comparisons are noisy; C looked best on entries-per-click, B best on raw clicks.
- The pixel reports "Photo entered" as a SIGN_UP-type conversion; figures above are what X attributes to the campaign.
